aiChecking.message: Checking whether the AI can run on this Chrome…

aiQuickSummary.message: Summarize this lecture in five bullet points.

aiUnavailable.message: This Chrome cannot run the built-in AI.

aiUnavailableHow.message: It needs Chrome 138 or newer on a desktop with enough free disk space. Everything else in SideNote works without it.

appDesc.message: Turns the audio of the lecture tab into live captions on your device, and keeps your notes and screenshots beside them.

bgOffscreenJustification.message: Processes the lecture tab's audio to turn it into live captions.

bgScreenshotPermission.message: To capture the screen, click the SideNote icon in the toolbar on the lecture tab once, then try again.

bgScriptFailed.message: Could not read the video's subtitles: $p1$

bgScriptNotFound.message: This video has no subtitles to import.

bgScriptPermission.message: Click the SideNote icon on this tab first, then try again.

bgTabCapturePermission.message: No permission to capture this tab's audio. Click the extension icon in the toolbar on the lecture tab once, then try again. (Navigating to another page resets this permission.)

bgTabClosed.message: The lecture tab was closed, so captions stopped.

bgTabNavigated.message: The tab moved to another page, so captions stopped.

err_AI_UNAVAILABLE.message: The on-device AI is not available.

err_IMAGE_CROP_FAILED.message: Cropping to the video area failed, so the whole screen was saved.

err_SCRIPT_NOT_FOUND.message: There are no subtitles to import.

err_STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED.message: Saving failed. Please try again in a moment.

err_STT_RATE_LIMITED.message: Too many speech recognition requests; this will take a moment.

err_TAB_CAPTURE_FAILED.message: Couldn't start capturing this tab's audio.

err_TAB_CAPTURE_PERMISSION_DENIED.message: No permission to capture this tab's audio. Click the extension icon in the toolbar on the lecture tab once, then try again.

err_VIDEO_ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND.message: No playing video was found, so the whole screen was saved.

sttAvailabilityCheckFailed.message: Couldn't check whether speech recognition is available: $p1$

sttLangUnavailable.message: On-device speech recognition for $p1$ isn't available on this device. Add that language under Chrome Settings → Languages and try again. Notes and captures still work.

sttNetworkRequired.message: Speech recognition asked for the network. It may not be running on-device.

sttNoAudioTrack.message: There's no audio track to recognize.

sttNoOffscreenSupport.message: Chrome's built-in speech recognition isn't available in this context (offscreen not supported).

sttNoOnDevice.message: This Chrome doesn't support on-device speech recognition (processLocally). Captions were not started, so that no audio leaves your computer. Please update Chrome to version 139 or later. Notes and captures still work.

sttPackDownloading.message: Downloading the $p1$ speech pack (first run only, a few hundred MB). Captions start automatically when it finishes.

sttPackIncomplete.message: The $p1$ speech pack download hasn't finished. Start again once it's done.

sttPackNotStarted.message: The $p1$ speech pack download didn't start. Press [Start captions] once more.

sttPackReady.message: The $p1$ speech pack is ready. Starting captions.

sttPackUnavailable.message: The $p1$ speech pack isn't available. Add that language under Chrome Settings → Languages and try again.

sttRestartFailed.message: Couldn't restart speech recognition. Press [Start captions] again.

sttTooManyRestarts.message: Speech recognition kept dropping, so it stopped. Press [Start captions] again.

sttUnavailableKind.message: Speech recognition is unavailable ($p1$). Notes and captures still work.

studyFooter.message: Made by SideNote from this lecture's materials. Everything was generated on this computer.

uiCannotSwitchWhileCapturing.message: You can't switch notes while captions are running. Press Stop first.

uiCaptionLanguageSame.message: Pick the same language as the speech and captions stay exactly as spoken.

uiCaptionSettingsHint.message: Changes apply the next time you press [Start captions].

uiCaptionSettingsLead.message: Captions are translated into the language you pick.

uiClearCurrentCaptionsTitle.message: Clears only this video's captions. Notes and captures stay.

uiCopiedCaptureAndMemo.message: Copied the capture together with its note.

uiCroppedFallback.message: Couldn't find the playing video area, so the whole screen was saved.

uiEmptyCaptions.message: Press Start captions and the audio of the video you're watching will stack up here.

uiHistoryHint.message: When the video changes, captions start over automatically; come back to a video and its captions continue. History is stored only in this browser (IndexedDB).

uiKeepAliveTitle.message: Keep making captions after you close this side panel. Turn it off and captions stop the moment the panel closes.

uiLanguageChangeWhileLive.message: Stop captions first to change the language.

uiMemoPlaceholder.message: Thoughts on the whole lecture, questions, things to study next...

uiNeedsInvoke.message: To use captions and captures on this tab, click the SideNote icon in the toolbar once. SideNote only works on the tab where you clicked the icon. (Chrome resets this permission whenever the page navigates.)

uiNewCaptionSessionTitle.message: Starts fresh captions, notes and captures for this video. Everything so far stays in History.

uiNewNoteStarted.message: Started a new note. The previous one is still in History.

uiNoTranscriptToCopy.message: There are no captions to copy yet.

uiNothingToClear.message: There are no captions to clear.

uiOffTabWarn.message: You have a note open from a different lecture than the tab you're on. Captions and capture are locked for now.

uiOverlayHint.message: Captions are drawn over the video. This list holds the captions of the video you're watching now; move to another video and a new set starts. The old ones stay under History.

uiPinnedNote.message: You're viewing a note opened from History. It stays put even if you switch tabs.

uiPngNeedsImage.message: A note without an image can't be saved as PNG. Use Copy, or include it in Save all.

uiSavedBundle.message: Saved $p1$ captures · $p2$ notes · $p3$ caption lines into a single HTML file.

uiSavedPng.message: Saved the capture and its note as a PNG.

uiScriptEmpty.message: Press [Import subtitles] to bring in the subtitles this video already carries. Nothing has to be played or listened to.

uiScriptHint.message: This reads the subtitle track the video itself carries, so it is exact and instant. It works on the tab where you clicked the SideNote icon, and only if that video has subtitles.

uiSessionListReadFailed.message: Couldn't read the saved note list.

uiTagline.message: Watch the lecture, read the captions, keep the notes — in one place.

uiTimelineHint.message: Capture puts the current screen here; Note only puts the current playback position here. Both stack in time order.

uiTranscriptCleared.message: Cleared $p1$ caption lines. Notes and captures are untouched.

uiTranslateUnsupported.message: This Chrome has no built-in translator, so captions stay in the original language.
